description: Book a home-service appointment — plumbing, HVAC, roofing, electrical and other trades — with a Canopy-connected business, with real availability in the customer's ZIP code area. Canopy routes by the business's booking mode: auto-confirm (booked right away in its calendar; the customer is emailed a confirmation), request-times (propose preferred times), or submission-only (callback request). Summarize the booking and get the customer's go-ahead before calling.

agent_callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL for the business's response.

customer.description: The customer the appointment or callback is for.

address.description: Where the work will be done. Ask for it when the visit is at the customer's home or business: some scheduling systems can't book without it.

street.description: Street address, e.g. "605 E Main Street, Apt 2".

email.description: Customer's email address. Mode 1 sends the confirmation code here.

notes.description: What the customer needs, in their words.

customer_zip.description: Customer's ZIP code, if known; picks the nearest location for multi-location businesses unless location_id decides. The result names the location used.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key on retries so nothing is created twice.

notes.description: Extra details for the business (added to the customer notes).

preferred_times.description: 1 to 3 preferred time windows (businesses that review requests).

starts_at.description: Start, ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-20T14:00:00-04:00.

service_id.description: Service to book (from get_availability). Needed for instant-confirm and preferred-times businesses.
